name: How long does it take to replace a toilet in Albany?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a toilet in Albany?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing a toilet in Albany typically takes a few hours, assuming no unexpected complications. This includes removing the old toilet, preparing the area, installing the new toilet, and testing for leaks. If there are issues with the existing flange, water supply line, or flooring, the process may take longer. We aim for efficient service with minimal disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Toilet replacement in Albany usually takes a few hours, but may take longer if there are issues with the existing plumbing or flooring.
